svg.data-regions-by: Claude (Opus 5.5), 2026-11-01: re-drafted under profile 2 by a script of Claude's from the draft of the same day. Each region's ink is what a watershed on the photograph's luminance gives its seeds: the seeds of the draft's regions that were in one group, those lent to one letter, or to a sign of one written part, joined as one region; and seeds that Claude placed by eye, with the transcription in hand, in written parts that had none and near junctions. The draft's cuts and its regions in two groups are dropped. The groups' ids, kinds, owners and notes, and the supplied ink's reasons, are the draft's, but where a group's note says otherwise; an id sN in them names a stroke of the stroke-SVG. Strips of vellum whose reason says so are proposed by the script, where the boundary between two signs' regions is pale. The lamed's group g18 is Claude's, from Ben's words of 2026-11-01 (statement 64). On 2026-11-02, under profile 3, Claude's overlap ov1 of the lamed and the mem, the cut c4 below it and the strip v1 between the geresh and the tav were dropped, as the plan's profile 3 says, and g18 is fitted.
